title: Provident fund remittance due dates
description: When an employer remits a wage month's provident fund, pension and insurance contributions and charges, in each instrument's words: within fifteen days of the close of the month, and, for an establishment exempted under section 143 of the Code on Social Security, 2020, the transfer of its contributions to its board of trustees by the fifteenth of the month that follows. Until 28 June 2026 the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952 and the Employees' Deposit-Linked Insurance Scheme, 1976, continued by section 164(2) of the Code, set the days; from 29 June 2026 the Schemes of 2026; the inspection charges' day is that of S.O. 2701(E). The Pension Fund's day before 29 June 2026 was not read in its instrument. A time the Central Provident Fund Commissioner extends under paragraph 28(3) of the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026 is not held.

choices.title: Within this many days of the close of the month
By this day of the month that follows

instruments: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 1952, paragraph 38(1), and Employees' Deposit-Linked Insurance Scheme, 1976, paragraph 8(1), as EPFO's consolidated texts print them, in force until the Schemes of 2026 superseded them on 29 June 2026

rows.source: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, paragraphs 20(1) and 28(3)

cells.name: Provident Fund contributions and administrative charges
cells.wording: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, paragraph 20(1): The employer shall, in the first instance, pay both the employer's contribution and the employee's contribution, together with administrative charges or other fees or charges payable under this Scheme in respect of an employee directly employed by him or through a contractor [in respect of such establishment, which is not registered independently], within fifteen days of the close of every month in the manner specified by the Central Board. Paragraph 28(3): The employer shall, within fifteen days of the close of every month, remit the contributions to the Fund through electronic mode of payment authorised for such collection on account of contributions and administrative charges:

cells.name: The employer's part of the contribution, into the Pension Fund
cells.wording: Employees' Pension Scheme, 2026, paragraph 4(1): … a part of contribution of eight and thirty-three hundredths per cent. of the wages of employee up to wage ceiling notified by the Central Government, shall be remitted by the employer to the Pension Fund within fifteen days of the close of every month in the account of the Central Board …

cells.name: Insurance Fund contributions and administrative charges
cells.wording: Employees' Deposit-Linked Insurance Scheme, 2026, paragraph 6(1): The employer shall, within fifteen days of the close of every month pay the contribution and administrative charges to the Insurance Fund through electronic mode (including digital payment) of agency banks listed with the Reserve Bank of India or scheduled banks or payment gateway or through the PayGov platform, authorised for such collection and cost of remittance, if any, shall be borne by the employer.

cells.name: An exempted establishment's contributions, to its board of trustees
cells.wording: Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, paragraph 13(7): The employer shall transfer contributions payable by the employer and employees to the board of trustees by the 15th of each month following the month for which contributions are due, failing which the employer shall be liable for interest and damages under sections 127 and 128 of the Code.
